name: Lemon Garlic Chicken Carrot Beans
description: Chicken with carrots and green beans, served as a skillet meal with lemon and garlic.
ingredients: 350 g boneless chicken thigh, cut into 2 cm pieces
200 g carrots, cut into thin batons
150 g green beans, trimmed and halved
steps: Wash and prepare the vegetables and herbs. Keep the raw protein and its utensils separate from the fresh produce.
Heat the oil in a wide pan. Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Add the carrot batons, green beans. Cook for 8–10 minutes, until tender. Move the vegetables to a plate.
Add the chicken to the pan. Add the black pepper and salt. Cook for 12–16 minutes, turning the pieces. Continue cooking if needed.
Check the thickest chicken piece with a food thermometer. It must reach 74°C.
Add the lemon juice just before serving.
Add the parsley before serving.
Taste before adding more salt. Serve hot.
tip: Use a food thermometer to check the chicken. Cooking times can change with piece size.

ingredients: 450 g boneless mutton, cut into 2 cm pieces
80 g fenugreek leaves, washed and chopped
steps: Wash and prepare the vegetables and herbs. Keep the raw protein and its utensils separate from the fresh produce.
Heat the oil in a deep pan. Brown the mutton for 6–8 minutes and move it to a plate.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic. Stir for 1 minute. Add the cumin and salt.
Return the mutton to the pan. Add 600 ml water, bring to a simmer and cover. Cook gently for 60 minutes.
Add the fenugreek leaves, tomatoes. Simmer for 20–30 minutes, until the mutton is tender. Add a little water if the pan becomes dry.
Check the thickest meat piece with a food thermometer. It must reach at least 63°C. Rest the meat for 3 minutes before serving.
Take the pan off the heat. Let it cool for 2 minutes. Stir in the yoghurt a spoonful at a time.
Add the coriander before serving.
Taste before adding more salt. Serve hot.
tip: Tenderness depends on the cut. Allow more simmering time for firm meat.
